name: Supercharged Daily Briefing
description: Stop spending your mornings hunting for news, trends, and updates across a dozen tabs. The Supercharged Daily Briefing turns OpenClaw into a production-grade research team that discovers the best sources for YOUR interests, monitors them around the clock, and delivers a personalized executive summary every morning. You pick the topics — OpenClaw finds the signal, cuts the noise, and puts it right where you chat.
